en: Good day. The palace is closed to visitors this week. The master is entertaining, you understand.
Good day. The palace is closed to visitors this week... Oh? Monsieur Aubert sent you?
A Snorlax on the south road, again. The last one slept there for a whole summer, I recall.
Very well. The master would want the road open. Take the palace's flute, and do bring it back one day.
Play the flute close to the sleeper and it will wake. It has never failed the palace yet.
